narrative: 空气本身必须被拍出来。一座大教堂、一片森林、一个烟雾弥漫的档案室：光束就是建筑本身。
光源暗示着画框之外还有一个世界。没有微粒，你只能看到光落在哪里，看不到它走过的路径。
在干净的空气中如果你仍然想要光柱，或者雾气浓到让每个景深平面都变得扁平时，它就不是合适的工具。没有灯具的、孤立悬浮的发光条纹不是体积光（Volumetric Light）。
how: 你需要一个方向性光源（常常是硬朗的，位置略后或略高）和一种散射介质：雾气、尘埃、雨、烟。摄影机通常需要看到光束的一部分角度，这也是为什么逆光会有帮助。
颜色跟随光源：暖色的阳光、冷色的窗光、白色的探照灯。限制雾气浓度，让前景和背景依然能够分离。
提示词：Volumetric rays through haze around [Subject], visible beams, dust in the shaft, cathedral or forest light as architecture.
when: 当空气本身是画面的一部分时使用：烟雾弥漫的室内，森林清晨，一束探照灯。不要在没有光源、没有介质的情况下添加漂浮的光条。
vs: 逆光是常常揭示出体积感的方向。空气感薄雾（Atmospheric Haze）是那种介质。
斑驳光（Dappled Light）把图案打在表面上；体积光把图案打在空气中。顿悟光（Epiphany）可能用到一道突然出现的光柱，但顿悟光是一种随理解而定时的变化。
如果人物保持暗色，剪影（Silhouette）可以置身于一道明亮的光柱之中。
examples_film: 《银翼杀手2049》（Blade Runner 2049）打造的室内，让尘埃和雾气使光柱变得实体化。《生命之树》（The Tree of Life）让森林和室内的阳光变成可见的建筑元素。
《银翼杀手》（Blade Runner，1982）中穿过烟雾的探照灯，正是同样的物理规律。
mistakes: 最常见的误用，是没有空气感的逆光轮廓，或画出来的“神光”贴纸。破绽是那些条纹既不理会灯具，也不理会人物身体。
解决办法是加入一种散射介质和一个真实的后方或高位光源，然后让身体去打断这道光束。

faq.q: 电影中的体积光是什么？
faq.a: 由雾气、雾霭、尘埃、烟雾或微粒使其可见的光束。你拍摄的是光的路径，而不仅仅是它落下的地方。

faq.q: 体积光和逆光有什么区别？
faq.a: 逆光是来自后方的方向。体积光是在介质中被可见化的光束。逆光常常帮助你看到这道光束。
当空气、尘埃或烟雾应该成为可见的建筑元素时使用。在干净的空气中，或者雾气会压平每一个景深平面时，就不要用它。

faq.q: AI 图像或视频中如何提示体积光？
faq.a: 指明一个真实光源和一种散射介质，可见的光束，光柱中的尘埃。身体可以打断这道光束。不要出现没有来源的发光条纹。

narrative: Air has to be photographed. A cathedral, a forest, a smoky archive: the beam is architecture.
The source implies a world outside the frame. Without particles you only see where the light lands, not the path it took.
It is the wrong tool in clean air if you still want shafts, or when haze is so thick that every depth plane flattens. Disconnected glowing stripes with no lamp are not volumetric light.
how: You need a directional source (often hard, slightly back or high) and a scattering medium: haze, dust, rain, smoke. The camera usually sees some of the beam angle, which is why backlight helps.
Color follows the source: warm sun, cool window, searchlight white. Limit haze so foreground and background still separate.
Prompt: Volumetric rays through haze around [Subject], visible beams, dust in the shaft, cathedral or forest light as architecture.
when: Use it when the air is part of the picture, a smoky interior, a forest morning, a searchlight. Do not add floating stripes with no source and no medium.
vs: Backlight is the direction that often reveals volume. Atmospheric haze is the medium.
Dappled light patterns surfaces; volume patterns the air. Epiphany may use a sudden shaft, but epiphany is a change timed to understanding.
Silhouette can sit inside a bright shaft if the figure stays dark.
examples_film: Blade Runner 2049 builds interiors where dust and haze make shafts physical. The Tree of Life lets forest and interior sun become visible architecture.
Blade Runner (1982) searchlights through smoke are the same physics.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a backlight rim with no air, or painted god-ray stickers. The tell is stripes that ignore the lamp and the body.
Fix it by adding a scattering medium and a real rear or high source, then letting the body interrupt the beam.

faq.q: What is volumetric light in film?
faq.a: Beams made visible by haze, fog, dust, smoke, or particles. You photograph the path of the light, not only where it lands.
Backlight is the direction from behind. Volumetric light is the beam made visible in a medium. Backlight often helps you see that beam.

faq.q: When should I use volumetric light?
faq.a: Use it when air, dust, or smoke should be visible architecture. Skip it in clean air, or when haze would flatten every plane.

faq.q: How do I prompt volumetric light for AI image or video?
faq.a: Specify a real source and a scattering medium, visible beams, dust in the shaft. The body can interrupt the beam. No orphan glowing stripes.
